sources: Google Maps place 'Clark Creek South Campground' (34.10017,-84.68259, 4.4 stars, 109 reviews), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: Bartow County WebTrac site details, CCS 003-005, 007-028 ('Standard Electric Site: Accommodates 30 & 50 Amp', 'Water Hookups', 'Dump Station on Site, No Sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 36 RV sites, all back-in: 26 with water and 30/50 A power (lengths 15-40 ft; 19 take a 23-ft rig) and 10 with no hookups (18-40 ft). Four more are tent only. Site 10 needs a 50-ft extension cord. 22 sites are tagged waterfront in the booking system, 8 of them with power.

sites.source: https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/departments/clark_creek_south.php (per-site list: power/water #3-5, 7-28; no hookups #1-2, 29, 30, 32-37, 40; tents #31, 38, 39; #6 tent with water); county map 2025 update ('50 foot extension power cord needed' at 10); WebTrac CCS 001-040 ('Equipment length/Driveway: 40' Back-In' etc., 'WF' tags), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/9939_BCPR_ClarkCreekSouthCampground_2025updates_06-19-25.jpg ('REST ROOM AND SHOWER', 'DUMP STATION'); WebTrac 'Dump Station on Site', read 2026-10-29

season.source: https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/departments/clark_creek_south.php ('Season runs from March 1st through October 31st'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Bartow County's WebTrac reservation site or the campground office, 770-607-6245. Golden Age / Access pass holders call the office to add the pass before booking. 14 nights in any 30 days at county campgrounds, then away 16 days. Two parking passes per site.

booking.source: https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/departments/clark_creek_south.php (WebTrac link; '2 Parking passes per site'; pass-holder line with 770-607-6245); https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/departments/parksandrecreation/parks_and_facilities.php ('We now require a 2 night minimum stay at all campgrounds on Friday and Saturday nights'); Campground Rules rev. 2024-06-19, read 2026-10-29

values.note: $24 a night for a no-hookup site, $30 for water and power, $34 for a waterfront site with water and power; the same weekday and Saturday (June 2027). $10 fee on any cancellation.

fees.source: Bartow County WebTrac rental search for 06/15/2027 and 06/19/2027: CCS no-hookup sites '$24.00', CCS 011-025/027-028 '$30.00', CCS 003-005/007-010/026 (WF) '$34.00'; Campground Rules rev. 2024-06-19 ('ALL CANCELLATIONS WILL INCUR A $10.00 CANCELLATION FEE'), read 2026-10-29

note: Bartow County Parks & Recreation campground on USACE Allatoona Lake land, Glade Rd, Acworth. Two-lane boat ramp and swim beach. --Claude
summary: County page + 2025 county map + WebTrac: 40 sites = 26 water/30-50 A (19 take 23 ft) + 10 no-hookup RV + 4 tent; all back-in; no sewer, dump + shower house; $24/$30/$34 (stored $22/$34 and 18 E/W were stale); Mar 1-Oct 31; 2-night weekend minimum, 14 in 30. Lakefront supported (22 WF-tagged sites; county map shows loops along the shore). Pin sits inside the campground loops; Google's pin is the entrance/boat-ramp parking ~340 m NW. Note trimmed of counts/rates/season/booking.
